purpose: Teach: 割高/協業/行程/必勝/品切れ/伝言/月給/当座

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、輸入品が割高で苦労されたぞ
lines.en: Your father struggled with import costs during the founding years, you know.
lines.style: Measured, conversational tone. Gentle weight on the memory—speaking from lived experience. Warm but grounded, like sharing a fact that still matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは他社との協業を積極的に進められました
lines.en: Yes. He pushed hard on partnerships with other companies to solve that.
lines.style: Respectful agreement. Quiet certainty on the acknowledgment. Honoring the memory while staying precise. Voice steady, eyes steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、新製品の行程表を綿密に立てられたぞ
lines.en: Your father mapped out the new product schedule with real care and detail.
lines.style: Slower tempo, almost reverent. Pause slightly before 'detail.' The affection is in the precision—admiring how thoroughly he thought things through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは必勝の心構えを社員に教えられました
lines.en: Yes. He taught the whole staff to think with a winning mindset.
lines.style: Quiet respect in the voice. Not overselling it—just stating what he learned. Slight lean into 'taught,' like passing it forward matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、商品が品切れになった時、悔しがられたぞ
lines.en: Your father was genuinely upset when products went out of stock.
lines.style: Softer now. The concern beneath the memory. Speaking of something that hurt him—recognizing that care cost him something.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはご家族への伝言を欠かさなかった
lines.en: Yes. He never once forgot to reach out to the family about what was happening.
lines.style: Warmth here, steady and real. The 'never forgot' lands with quiet significance. Honoring a quiet kind of loyalty that ran through everything.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の月給を業界トップ水準にされたぞ
lines.en: Your father kept the staff salaries at the top of the industry standard.
lines.style: Admiration in the voice without theatrics. Slight rise on 'top'—the pride of someone who knew what that cost and why it mattered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは当座の資金繰りも工夫されました
lines.en: Yes. And he was clever about managing the cash flow too, even when it was tight.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. The 'and' carries weight—he's adding a final piece. Wisdom closing the door gently. Like the end of a story well-told.
